paper.title: ARIA: Training Language Agents with Intention-driven Reward Aggregation
paper.summary: Large language models (LLMs) have enabled agents to perform complex reasoning and decision-making through free-form language interactions

candidates.title: Learning to See Before Seeing: Demystifying LLM Visual Priors from Language Pre-training
candidates.summary: Explore and understand the visual priors within LLMs and thus build better MLLMs.

candidates.title: Task-Optimized Convolutional Recurrent Networks Align with Tactile Processing in the Rodent Brain
candidates.summary: Task-optimized convolutional recurrent neural networks trained on realistic tactile inputs align with rodent somatosensory data, suggesting brain tactile processing uses temporally-precise representations shaped by categorization-driven optimization.

candidates.title: Locality in Image Diffusion Models Emerges from Data Statistics
candidates.summary: Recent work has shown that the generalization ability of image diffusion models arises from the locality properties of the trained neural network

candidates.title: The Polar Express: Optimal Matrix Sign Methods and their Application to the Muon Algorithm
candidates.summary: We introduce a GPU-friendly algorithm for computing the polar decomposition of a matrix to low accuracy that is optimal in its class. This improves Muon.
